text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets.

I’d be glad to help you build a practical project tracking template in PowerPoint and Excel for your real-estate development team. From your post, I understand you need something that can help top management quickly review project milestones and timelines, budgeted vs. actual costs, and overall project status across multiple developments. I can create a clear, management-friendly template that is easy to update, easy to read, and structured to support regular reporting.

A project like this works best when the Excel file is designed as the source of truth, with organized fields for project name, milestone status, target dates, actual progress, budget, actual cost, variance, and notes. Then, the PowerPoint version can present the same information in a polished executive format for leadership reviews. My focus would be on making the structure simple enough for ongoing use while still giving management the key insights they need at a glance.

One relevant project I built was an HR attrition dashboard for a confidential manufacturing client. I used Power BI, Excel, and SQL to create an attrition and absence dashboard where each plant manager could only see their own plant. That dashboard covered 1,900 employees and helped identify attrition hotspots in 2 plants. This experience is relevant because it required building a reporting structure that was both clean and practical for leadership review, with attention to usability and clear visibility of status.

If selected, I would make sure the template is organized, professional, and easy for your team to maintain over time. I can also help ensure the layout supports fast updates and clear presentation for top management meetings.

I’d be happy to discuss your preferred reporting format, the fields you want to track, and how detailed the milestone and cost tracking should be.
